claims: GO1-C1: one gnd evolve apply parses at most 3 times and one preview at most 2, the same at two model sizes and for a YAML and a .json workspace; with the scope off the counts are 22 and 6.

GO1-C2: for the cases of the focused evolve lane and for an include root, a .json model, a YAML model with a value JSON cannot spell, a policy refusal and a D-12 refusal, every output byte, message and exit is identical with the scope on and off.

GO1-C3: no remembered document differs at scope close from what the parser built, and the write check (set_parse_scope_verify) detects any write, including one made through a loaded Model, without false positives on values JSON cannot spell.
GO1-C4: a model file changed between preview and apply is refused as today, a second command in the same process parses again, and nothing remembered outlives its outermost scope or crosses threads.
R0.2: no validation, guard, digest comparison or refusal is removed or reordered; a parse that raises is never remembered and its refusal names the caller's own source.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch this change adds handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.
